risk.detail: Branch contains only a test file addition (173 lines). No production code changes. The parent UC (fix-agent-retry-rate) is already marked complete and the implementation was shipped via a different branch (dev/172bbb0b / PR #1913). The test on this branch tests _buildExportRiskWarnings() improvements that were part of the same UC — the test was never merged, making this branch stale test work that was superseded when the UC was completed by a different dev attempt. Five sibling orphan branches (same prefix, different SHA) exist for the same problem, all of which have their own investigation tasks queued, indicating a spawn-loop that created multiple competing attempts before any merged.

recommendation: safe-delete — The UC this branch was addressing is complete. The test file it adds does not exist on main and its subject function (_buildExportRiskWarnings improvements) was addressed by the merged implementation on dev/172bbb0b. Merging this stale test-only branch risks introducing tests that reference genome internals that may have changed since 2026-05-05. No action needed on the UC. Branch can be deleted after the other four sibling orphan investigations confirm the same pattern.
